tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is his official portrait, guiding character identity, costume and polished anime illustration style. Image 2 is his in-game model, guiding accurate face, hair, skin tone, outfit and accessories. His face looks toward the viewer, with a calm neutral resting expression, relaxed brows and a closed level mouth. Petite Medium Male proportions. Stand in a relaxed three-quarter body angle with a gentle weight shift, right hand resting naturally on his hip and left arm lowered, hand relaxed at his side. Hair and clothing hang naturally. Each hand has a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb with natural articulation, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes visible with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
